current_harness_limitation: Chapter-coincidence cap treats psalm=chapter identity as chapter-fallback, forcing medium_low on ~149 genuinely high-confidence whole-psalm units and flooding sidecars (315/474 rows).
observed_problem: Every whole-psalm chunk (and Lam poems, Job speech-chapters, Dan/Rev tale-vision chapters) was auto-capped despite strong literary evidence.
recommended_harness_change: Add chapter_coincident_literary_identity flag justified in book strategy; cap only when literary evidence tags are absent.

current_harness_limitation: Substrate attributes psalm superscription d markers to the previous psalm's final verse.
observed_problem: Ps 3's title registers at Ps 2:12; titleless Ps 10 shows d@18 (= Ps 11's title). Systematic off-by-one for any d-based boundary logic.
recommended_harness_change: Fix/verify inter-verse marker attribution in the Rust scanner; document d semantics in substrate control file.

current_harness_limitation: Embedded hymns/creeds printed as prose carry no poetry markers, so the protocol's poetry triggers never fire.
observed_problem: Kenosis hymn, Col 1:15-20, Titus 2:11-14, 1Pet 3:18-22 undetectable from substrate; only 1Tim 3:16 and 2Tim 2:11-13 are q-marked.
recommended_harness_change: Ship a curated candidate hymn/creed span inventory in the shared research baseline (evidence-only).

current_harness_limitation: Acrostic detection is formatting-dependent; WEB sets Nahum without q markers.
observed_problem: Partial alphabetic acrostic invisible; likewise Ps 9-10/25/34/37/111/112/145 acrostics carry no acrostic signal.
recommended_harness_change: Add an acrostic inventory (book, span, letters, completeness) to the baseline; wire it to a validator trigger.

current_harness_limitation: Refrain-bounded units have no substrate signal; chapter-aligned tools will split them.
observed_problem: 'His hand is stretched out still' binds 9:8-10:4 across the chapter break; same for Amos 4 and Song adjuration refrains.
recommended_harness_change: Add n-gram refrain-recurrence detection to the Rust substrate (verse-granular repeated-line index).

current_harness_limitation: Hebrew/Aramaic language shifts are hard discourse boundaries absent from the substrate.
observed_problem: Ezra 4:8; 6:18; 7:12-26 and Dan 2:4b-7:28 panels invisible; Dan 7 genre/language cross-cut needed manual handling.
recommended_harness_change: Surface language_shift risk flag from Strong's lemma ranges or source lexeme tables.

current_harness_limitation: Protocol frames sentence-proverb collections only as chapter-fallback deficiency.
observed_problem: Chapters 10-21 and 25-29 have zero b breaks and no literary sub-boundaries; chapter cuts are conventions, not failures.
recommended_harness_change: Add no_internal_boundary_literature category; compare harness should expect arbitrary disagreement there and down-weight it.

current_harness_limitation: One confidence scalar conflates boundary-confidence with content pressure.
observed_problem: Longer ending has certain boundaries but maximal variant pressure; same tension at Isa 52:13-53:12 (certain boundary, maximal theology pressure).
recommended_harness_change: Add boundary_confidence and content_pressure fields; keep confidence as min for compatibility.

current_harness_limitation: No schema way to flag merge-direction (unit may join its neighbor).
observed_problem: Ps 9-10 single broken acrostic, Ps 42-43 shared refrain: LXX joins; MT splits; sidecars can only say 'split further'.

current_harness_limitation: No speaker_attribution_status field; models can only prose-flag undecided voice boundaries.
observed_problem: John 3:16-21/31-36 voice ends, Job 27-28, Rev 22:6-21, Song sp-marked turns all needed ad-hoc concern strings.
recommended_harness_change: Add speaker_attribution_status enum (none_asserted|marked_editorial|owner_review_pending) to chunk/sidecar schema.

current_harness_limitation: WJ evidence is per-verse counts; run extents are not exposed.
observed_problem: Continuous WJ runs cross pericope seams silently (Matt 23-25; 5-7); run boundaries would be direct discourse-edge evidence.
recommended_harness_change: Emit wj_run_start/wj_run_end observations in the substrate.

current_harness_limitation: x crossrefs mark quotation presence, not extent.
observed_problem: Longest NT quotation (Jer 31:31-34) has no machine-readable block extent; catenae in Heb 1 and Rom 3 likewise.
recommended_harness_change: Add quotation-span extent records (start/end verse) to the substrate or baseline.

current_harness_limitation: No versification/canonical-order sensitivity field for MT/LXX structural divergence.
observed_problem: Jer 25 is the LXX insertion hinge; Joel/Malachi/Jonah English-Hebrew offsets handled ad hoc in prose notes.
recommended_harness_change: Add versification_sensitivity enum field to chunk schema; auto-populate from a divergence table.

current_harness_limitation: Isolation validator fails closed on pre-existing working-tree modifications it did not cause.
observed_problem: Run failed validate_t423_parallel_isolation.py due to a one-line owner WIP edit to comparison/model_agreement_matrix.yaml that predates this session; all M6 writes are untracked files in the model folder.
recommended_harness_change: Pin forbidden-path hashes at marathon start and fail only on changes since pin.

current_harness_limitation: No field to declare deliberate divergence from (or coincidence with) governed spans encountered during mandatory preflight.
observed_problem: My idol-food unit ends at 11:1 while governed parent gold ends at 10:33; my Eph 1:3-14 coincides with T394 gold; both needed ad-hoc sidecar notes to keep compare honest about independence.
